rows.item: weather hood, rain louvre, bird screen
inlet-air cooler (chilled-water coil, 15 C off-coil) + droplet eliminator
duct, transition and fabric joint to the plenum flange

coarse.note: 4 struts, R10 shroud corner (sec. 15.6 contour), no splitter

fine.note: 4 struts, R10 shroud corner (sec. 15.6 contour), no splitter

medium.note: 4 struts, R10 shroud corner (sec. 15.6 contour), no splitter

coarse.note: A + 8 mm bottom splitter plate (y = 0, plenum floor up to the slot entry radius)
A + annular turning ring in the bend (mid-slot x 180.5 from r 200, quarter ellipse to x 208 / r 106)
what-if: FB / thrust bearing 25 mm forward (rotor change): hub wall x 132, stretched fairing, shroud R35 at x 179

design.services: none: the struts are solid. Oil supply (JB1, TB), buffer air, drain DN65, vent DN25 and the sensor leads leave the front bearing housing forward through the dry tunnel (ambient, open at x -140), so no line crosses the filtered air and no strut seal is needed

thermal.note: FB-2 feet: centre-line support; the foot bolts need slotted holes in y (or a bottom centre key) so the housing grows sideways without moving the axis; hub-wall seal face on the FB fairing (r 130-150) has 0.5 mm radial clearance and a cord O-ring, it does not locate

refs.filters: ISO 16890 / EN 779 F7 + F9 two-stage static filtration for gas turbines: clean 80-150 Pa per stage, change-out 250-450 Pa (filter makers' GT data); rating basis mid-life
refs.plenum: Idelchik (2008) ch. 7: side-fed annular collecting chamber; radial-inlet practice: plenum velocity <= ~1/3 of the slot entry velocity, slot / eye area 2-3, rounded hub-side lip
refs.struts: streamlined struts, Cd ~0.06-0.10 on the frontal area at Re ~1e5 (Hoerner 1965)
refs.bend: accelerating 90 deg annular bend into the eye: K 0.03-0.08 on the eye head (radial inlets of centrifugal compressors)
